```{r}
# labels
BARREN_LABEL <- "Barren"
FOREST_LABEL <- "Macro_Forest"

HABITAT_PREDICTORS <- c("ACI", "NDSI", "AEI", "ADI")
URCHIN_PREDICTORS  <- c("ACI", "NDSI")

HAB_LEVELS <- c("Urchin Barren", "Macrocystis Forest")

# fixed left-to-right site order: forests first, then barrens
SITE_ORDER <- c("Battery_Island", "Crow_Island", "Middle_Island",   # forests
                "Harris_Island", "Sandy_Cove", "Samsing_Cove")       # barrens

# time
SITE_TZ    <- "America/Sitka"   # deployment is Sitka, AK (AKDT = UTC-8 in July)
SOURCE_TZ  <- "UTC"             # HydroMoth RTC records UTC

PLOT_DATES <- as.Date(c("2025-07-24", "2025-07-25", "2025-07-26", "2025-07-27"))

# paths
library(here)

ACOUSTIC_DIR <- here("data", "acoustic_data", "filtered_data")

PATH_CCA  <- here(ACOUSTIC_DIR, "Sage_Constraints_Experiment_CCA Urchin Indices.csv")
PATH_ROCK <- here(ACOUSTIC_DIR, "Sage_Constraints_Experiment_Bare Rock Urchin Indices.csv")
PATH_KELP <- here(ACOUSTIC_DIR, "Sage_Constraints_Experiment_Kelp Urchin Indices.csv")
PATH_ECO  <- here("data", "ecological_data", "ecological_variables_summary.csv")

stopifnot(all(file.exists(PATH_CCA, PATH_ROCK, PATH_KELP, PATH_ECO)))

# SVM hyperparameters
SVM_KERNEL <- "rbfdot"
SVM_SIGMA  <- 0.25
SVM_COST   <- 1

# shared theme for all figures
theme_urchin <- function(base_size = 13, angle_x = 0) {
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.border       = element_blank(),
      axis.line          = element_line(colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks         = element_line(colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x        = element_markdown(angle = angle_x,          # <-- changed from element_text
                                             hjust = if (angle_x == 0) 0.5 else 1),
      plot.title         = element_text(size = base_size + 1, margin = margin(b = 8)),
      strip.background   = element_blank(),
      strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(0.85)),
      legend.position     = "bottom",
      legend.title        = element_text(size = rel(0.85)),
      legend.text         = element_markdown(size = rel(0.85)),
      axis.title.y        = element_text(size = rel(0.85), margin = margin(r = 4)),
      panel.spacing.x     = unit(1, "lines")
    )
}

hab_fill <- function(name = NULL) {
  scale_fill_manual(
    breaks = c("Macrocystis Forest", "Urchin Barren"),
    values = c("Macrocystis Forest" = "#00BFC4", "Urchin Barren" = "#F8766D"),
    labels = c("Macrocystis Forest" = "*Macrocystis* Forest",
               "Urchin Barren"      = "Urchin Barren"),
    name   = name
  )
}
```

## Habitat Model Data

```{r}
keep_rows <- complete.cases(all_data[, c(HABITAT_PREDICTORS, "TYPE")])
habitat_model_data <- all_data[keep_rows, ]

cat("Rows used:", nrow(habitat_model_data), "of", nrow(all_data), "\n")
print(table(habitat_model_data$TYPE))
```

## Clock Conversion

```{r}
stopifnot(inherits(habitat_model_data$full_datetime, "POSIXct"))

# If the tzone attribute is empty, R will treat it as system-local. Force UTC.
if (is.null(attr(habitat_model_data$full_datetime, "tzone")) ||
    attr(habitat_model_data$full_datetime, "tzone") == "") {
  attr(habitat_model_data$full_datetime, "tzone") <- SOURCE_TZ
}

habitat_model_data <- habitat_model_data %>%
  mutate(
    dt_local = with_tz(full_datetime, SITE_TZ),    
    DATE     = as.Date(dt_local, tz = SITE_TZ),    
    HOUR     = hour(dt_local)
  ) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("LOCAL.DATE..SITKA.", "LOCAL.TIME..SITKA.")))

# Verification: a UTC hour of 23 must become a Sitka hour of 15 (UTC-8).
cat("UTC vs Sitka offset check:\n")
print(head(data.frame(
  utc   = format(habitat_model_data$full_datetime[1:3], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"),
  local = format(habitat_model_data$dt_local[1:3],      "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"),
  DATE  = habitat_model_data$DATE[1:3],
  HOUR  = habitat_model_data$HOUR[1:3]
)))

# The date must match the LOCAL calendar day, not the UTC one.
stopifnot(all(habitat_model_data$DATE ==
              as.Date(format(habitat_model_data$dt_local, "%Y-%m-%d"))))
```

# Habitat SVM (Barren vs Macro_Forest)

```{r}
habitat_svm_model <- ksvm(
  TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI + AEI + ADI,
  data       = habitat_model_data,
  kernel     = SVM_KERNEL,
  kpar       = list(sigma = SVM_SIGMA),
  C          = SVM_COST,
  prob.model = TRUE,
  scaled     = TRUE
)             

cat("Support vectors:", habitat_svm_model@nSV, "\n")

train_pred <- predict(habitat_svm_model, newdata = habitat_model_data)
conf_mat   <- table(Actual = habitat_model_data$TYPE, Predicted = train_pred)
conf_rate  <- prop.table(conf_mat, margin = 1)

print(conf_mat)
print(round(conf_rate, 3))

misclass_rate <- 1 - sum(diag(conf_mat)) / sum(conf_mat)
cat("\nMisclassification rate:", round(misclass_rate, 7))
```

```{r}
habitat_svm_cv <- ksvm(
  TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI + AEI + ADI,
  data   = habitat_model_data,
  kernel = SVM_KERNEL,
  kpar   = list(sigma = SVM_SIGMA),
  C      = SVM_COST,
  cross  = 5,
  scaled = TRUE
)
cat("5-fold CV error:   ", round(cross(habitat_svm_cv), 7), "\n")
cat("5-fold CV accuracy:", round(1 - cross(habitat_svm_cv), 7), "\n") 
```

```{r}
  NDSI = seq(min(habitat_model_data$NDSI), max(habitat_model_data$NDSI), length.out = 150),
```

4-panel habitat response profile

```{r}
# Build plotting dataframe
plot_df <- habitat_model_data %>%
  dplyr::select(NDSI, ACI, ADI, AEI) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(prob_barren = habitat_model_data$prob_barren)

# Function to make one panel
make_panel <- function(df, index, color) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[index]], y = prob_barren)) +
    geom_point(color = color, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(color = "black", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = index, y = NULL)
}

# Build each panel
p1 <- make_panel(plot_df, "NDSI", "#648FFF")
p2 <- make_panel(plot_df, "ACI",  "#DC267F")
p3 <- make_panel(plot_df, "ADI",  "#FE6100")
p4 <- make_panel(plot_df, "AEI",  "#F9DE56")

# Combine
wrap_plots(p1, p2, p3, p4, nrow = 1) +
  plot_layout(axis_titles = "collect") &
  labs(y = "Probability of assignment as Urchin Barrens (SVM)") &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))

ggsave("habitat_svm_response_profile.png", width = 10, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
get_gtable_size <- function(g) {
  pdf(NULL)  # open invisible null device so convertWidth has context
  on.exit(dev.off())
  list(
    width  = sum(sapply(g$widths,  function(x) convertWidth(x, "in", valueOnly = TRUE))),
    height = sum(sapply(g$heights, function(x) convertHeight(x, "in", valueOnly = TRUE)))
  )
}

dim_type <- get_gtable_size(p_type_fx)
dim_site <- get_gtable_size(p_site_fx)

# add a small safety margin so nothing clips at the edge

       width = dim_type$width + 0.15, height = dim_type$height + 0.05, units = "in")
ggsave("fig_panelB_site.pdf", p_site_fx,
       width = dim_site$width + 0.15, height = dim_site$height + 0.05, units = "in")
```

# Urchin activity SVMs

Acoustics from three red urchins on different substrate/food types (CCA-covered rock, bare rock, bare rock with kelp), recorded at \~30 ft for 2 days each.

```{r}
fit_urchin_svm <- function(csv_path, urchin_label, present_out, absent_out,
                           seed = 123) {

  raw <- read.csv(csv_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  clean <- data.frame(
    TYPE = ifelse(trimws(raw$TYPE) == urchin_label, present_out, absent_out),
    ACI  = as.numeric(raw$ACI),
    NDSI = as.numeric(raw$NDSI)
  )
  clean <- na.omit(clean)
  clean$TYPE <- factor(clean$TYPE, levels = c(present_out, absent_out))

  if (any(table(clean$TYPE) == 0)) {
    stop("No rows matched '", urchin_label, "' in ", basename(csv_path),
         " — check the exact TYPE string.")
  }

  cat("\n===", present_out, "===\n")
  print(table(clean$TYPE))
  
  model <- ksvm(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = clean,
                kernel = SVM_KERNEL, kpar = list(sigma = SVM_SIGMA),
                C = SVM_COST, prob.model = TRUE, scaled = TRUE)

  cat("Kernel: RBF | C =", SVM_COST, "| sigma =", SVM_SIGMA, "\n")
  cat("Support vectors:", model@nSV, "of", nrow(clean),
      sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", 100 * model@nSV / nrow(clean)))
  
  pred      <- predict(model, newdata = clean)
  conf_mat  <- table(Actual = clean$TYPE, Predicted = pred)
  misclass  <- 1 - sum(diag(conf_mat)) / sum(conf_mat)

  print(conf_mat)
  cat("Misclassification rate:", round(misclass, 7), "\n")

  set.seed(seed)
  cv <- ksvm(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = clean,
             kernel = SVM_KERNEL, kpar = list(sigma = SVM_SIGMA),
             C = SVM_COST, cross = 5, scaled = TRUE)
  cat("5-fold CV accuracy:", round(1 - cross(cv), 7), "\n")

  list(model = model, data = clean, conf_mat = conf_mat,
       misclass = misclass, cv_error = cross(cv))
}
```

```{r}
cca_svm  <- fit_urchin_svm(PATH_CCA,  "URCHIN_CCA",
                           "URCHIN_CCA",        "NO_URCHIN_CCA")
rock_svm <- fit_urchin_svm(PATH_ROCK, "URCHINS_BARE ROCK",
                           "URCHINS_BARE_ROCK", "NO_URCHINS_BARE_ROCK")
kelp_svm <- fit_urchin_svm(PATH_KELP, "URCHIN_KELP",
                           "URCHIN_KELP",       "NO_URCHIN_KELP")
```

## Multiclass Urchin SVMs

```{r}
build_multiclass_data <- function(sources) {
  parts <- lapply(sources, function(s) {
    raw <- read.csv(s$path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    raw_type <- trimws(raw$TYPE)
    data.frame(
      TYPE = ifelse(raw_type %in% names(s$relabel), s$relabel[raw_type], raw_type),
      ACI  = as.numeric(raw$ACI),
      NDSI = as.numeric(raw$NDSI)
    )
  })
  clean <- na.omit(do.call(rbind, parts))
  clean
}

fit_multiclass_svm <- function(clean, group_name, seed = 123) {
  clean$TYPE <- factor(clean$TYPE)
  cat("\n===", group_name, "===\n")
  print(table(clean$TYPE))

  model <- ksvm(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = clean,
                kernel = SVM_KERNEL, kpar = list(sigma = SVM_SIGMA),
                C = SVM_COST, prob.model = TRUE, scaled = TRUE)
  cat("Kernel: RBF | C =", SVM_COST, "| sigma =", SVM_SIGMA, "\n")
  cat("Support vectors:", model@nSV, "of", nrow(clean),
      sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", 100 * model@nSV / nrow(clean)))

  pred     <- predict(model, newdata = clean)
  conf_mat <- table(Actual = clean$TYPE, Predicted = pred)
  misclass <- 1 - sum(diag(conf_mat)) / sum(conf_mat)
  print(conf_mat)
  cat("Misclassification rate:", round(misclass, 7), "\n")

  set.seed(seed)
  cv <- ksvm(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = clean,
             kernel = SVM_KERNEL, kpar = list(sigma = SVM_SIGMA),
             C = SVM_COST, cross = 5, scaled = TRUE)
  cat("5-fold CV accuracy:", round(1 - cross(cv), 7), "\n")

  list(model = model, data = clean, conf_mat = conf_mat,
       misclass = misclass, cv_error = cross(cv))
}
```

```{r}
three_class_data <- build_multiclass_data(
  sources = list(
    list(path = PATH_CCA,  relabel = c(
      "URCHIN_CCA"    = "URCHIN_HARD",
      "NO URCHIN_CCA" = "NO_URCHIN"
    )),
    list(path = PATH_ROCK, relabel = c(
      "URCHINS_BARE ROCK"    = "URCHIN_HARD",
      "NO URCHINS_BARE ROCK" = "NO_URCHIN"
    )),
    list(path = PATH_KELP, relabel = c(
      "URCHIN_KELP"    = "URCHIN_KELP",
      "NO URCHIN_KELP" = "NO_URCHIN"
    ))
  )
)

three_class_svm <- fit_multiclass_svm(three_class_data, "3-CLASS: NO_URCHIN vs URCHIN_HARD vs URCHIN_KELP")
```

```{r}
urchin_only <- subset(three_class_data, TYPE %in% c("URCHIN_HARD", "URCHIN_KELP"))
urchin_only$TYPE <- factor(urchin_only$TYPE)

urchin_substrate_svm <- fit_multiclass_svm(urchin_only, "URCHIN-ONLY: HARD vs KELP substrate signature")
```

```{r}
fit_weighted_svm <- function(clean, group_name, seed = 123) {
  clean$TYPE <- factor(clean$TYPE)
  cat("\n===", group_name, "(class-weighted) ===\n")
  print(table(clean$TYPE))

  # inverse-frequency weights so minority class isn't ignored
  counts <- table(clean$TYPE)
  weights <- as.list(sum(counts) / (length(counts) * counts))
  names(weights) <- names(counts)
  cat("Class weights:", paste(names(weights), round(unlist(weights), 3), sep = "=", collapse = ", "), "\n")

  model <- ksvm(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = clean,
                kernel = SVM_KERNEL, kpar = list(sigma = SVM_SIGMA),
                C = SVM_COST, prob.model = TRUE, scaled = TRUE,
                class.weights = unlist(weights))

  pred     <- predict(model, newdata = clean)
  conf_mat <- table(Actual = clean$TYPE, Predicted = pred)
  misclass <- 1 - sum(diag(conf_mat)) / sum(conf_mat)
  print(conf_mat)
  cat("Misclassification rate:", round(misclass, 7), "\n")

  set.seed(seed)
  cv <- ksvm(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = clean,
             kernel = SVM_KERNEL, kpar = list(sigma = SVM_SIGMA),
             C = SVM_COST, cross = 5, scaled = TRUE,
             class.weights = unlist(weights))
  cat("CV accuracy:", round(1 - cross(cv), 7), "\n")

  list(model = model, conf_mat = conf_mat, misclass = misclass, cv_error = cross(cv))
}

urchin_substrate_weighted <- fit_weighted_svm(urchin_only, "URCHIN-ONLY: HARD vs KELP (weighted)")
```

```{r}
cost_grid  <- seq(0.1, 5, length.out = 10)

  m <- tryCatch(
    ksvm(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = three_class_data,

  )

  }
}
```

```{r}
library(suncalc)
library(patchwork)

SITKA_LAT <- 57.0531
SITKA_LON <- -135.3309


habitat_model_data <- habitat_model_data %>%
  mutate(DATE = as.Date(LOCAL.DATE..SITKA.))

# --- night bands ---
sun_df <- getSunlightTimes(
  date = PLOT_DATES, lat = SITKA_LAT, lon = SITKA_LON,
  keep = c("sunrise", "sunset"), tz = SITE_TZ
) %>%
  mutate(DATE    = as.Date(date),
         sr_hour = hour(sunrise) + minute(sunrise) / 60,
         ss_hour = hour(sunset)  + minute(sunset)  / 60)
print(sun_df[, c("DATE", "sunrise", "sunset")])

night_df <- bind_rows(
  transmute(sun_df, DATE, xmin = 0,       xmax = sr_hour),
  transmute(sun_df, DATE, xmin = ss_hour, xmax = 24)
)

# --- aggregate acoustics (urchin_2c_prob, both habitats) and tide ---
agg_2c_combined <- habitat_model_data %>%
  filter(DATE %in% PLOT_DATES) %>%
  group_by(TYPE, DATE, HOUR) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(urchin_2c_prob, na.rm = TRUE),
            se    = sd(urchin_2c_prob, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")

tide <- noaa_tide %>%
  mutate(DATE = as.Date(datetime, tz = SITE_TZ),
         HOUR = hour(datetime) + minute(datetime) / 60) %>%
  filter(DATE %in% PLOT_DATES)

# --- shared layers ---
night_layer <- geom_rect(data = night_df,
                         aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
                         fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE)

hab_cols <- setNames(c("steelblue3", "firebrick3"),
                      c(FOREST_LABEL, BARREN_LABEL))

  facet_grid(. ~ DATE),

  theme_bw(base_size = 15),
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(r = 4)),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(0, "lines"),
        strip.background = element_blank())
)

no_x     <- theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
no_strip <- theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_blank())

# --- combined panel: both habitat types overlaid, colour-coded ---
p_2c_combined <- ggplot(agg_2c_combined, aes(HOUR, value, colour = TYPE)) +
  night_layer +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = value - se, ymax = value + se),
                width = 0, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.45, se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = hab_cols, name = "Habitat", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +   # SVM probability is bounded [0,1]
  base + no_x +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Predicted urchin probability (2-class SVM)") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# --- tide panel ---

  night_layer +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  base + no_strip +
  labs(x = "Hour (Sitka local)", y = "Tide (ft MLLW)")

# --- stack: combined panel on top, tide below ---
p_tidal_night_2c_combined <- p_2c_combined / p_tide +
  plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Urchin acoustic activity (both habitats), tidal cycle, and time of day (2-class SVM)"
  )

p_tidal_night_2c_combined
```

```{r}
                     kernel = "rbfdot", kpar = list(sigma = best5$sigma),
                     C = best5$C, prob.model = TRUE, scaled = TRUE)

cat("Support vectors:", best5_model@nSV, "of", nrow(five_class_data),
    sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", 100 * best5_model@nSV / nrow(five_class_data)))

pred5 <- predict(best5_model, newdata = five_class_data)
conf_mat5 <- table(Actual = five_class_data$TYPE, Predicted = pred5)
print(conf_mat5)

misclass5 <- 1 - sum(diag(conf_mat5)) / sum(conf_mat5)
cat("Training misclassification rate:", round(misclass5, 4), "\n")

set.seed(123)
cv5 <- ksvm(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = five_class_data,
            kernel = "rbfdot", kpar = list(sigma = best5$sigma),
            C = best5$C, cross = 5, scaled = TRUE)
cat("5-fold CV accuracy:", round(1 - cross(cv5), 4), "\n")
```

```{r}
cost_grid  <- seq(0.1, 5, length.out = 10)
gamma_grid <- seq(0.01, 0.5, length.out = 10)

results_eat <- expand.grid(C = cost_grid, sigma = gamma_grid)
results_eat$misclass <- NA_real_

for (i in 1:nrow(results_eat)) {
  m <- tryCatch(
    ksvm(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = eating_data,
         kernel = "rbfdot", kpar = list(sigma = results_eat$sigma[i]),
         C = results_eat$C[i], scaled = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (!is.null(m)) {
    pred <- predict(m, newdata = eating_data)
    results_eat$misclass[i] <- 1 - sum(pred == eating_data$TYPE) / nrow(eating_data)
  }
}

best_eat <- results_eat[which.min(results_eat$misclass), ]
print(best_eat)
```

```{r}
make_urchin_profile <- function(fit, title) {
  g <- expand.grid(
    ACI  = seq(min(fit$data$ACI),  max(fit$data$ACI),  length.out = 200),
    NDSI = seq(min(fit$data$NDSI), max(fit$data$NDSI), length.out = 200)
  )
  g$pred_class <- predict(fit$model, newdata = g)

  lv <- levels(fit$data$TYPE)
  ggplot(g, aes(NDSI, ACI, fill = pred_class)) +
    geom_raster(interpolate = TRUE, alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_point(data = fit$data, aes(NDSI, ACI, shape = TYPE),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#F4CCCC", "#C9DAF8"), lv),
                      name = "Predicted") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = setNames(c(16, 17), lv), name = "Actual") +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)
}
```

# Urchin PC1

```{r}
orient_pc1 <- function(pca, prob_df) {
  scores      <- pca$x[, "PC1"]
  mean_urchin <- rowMeans(prob_df)
  if (cor(scores, mean_urchin) < 0) {
    scores          <- -scores
    pca$rotation[, "PC1"] <- -pca$rotation[, "PC1"]   # keep loadings consistent
  }
  list(scores = scores, rotation = pca$rotation[, "PC1"])
}
```

```{r}
# Predict the three urchin SVMs onto every habitat row.
# newdata is built ONCE so all three models see identical input.
newdata_full <- data.frame(
  ACI  = as.numeric(habitat_model_data$ACI),
  NDSI = as.numeric(habitat_model_data$NDSI)
)
stopifnot(!anyNA(newdata_full))

urchin_prob_df <- data.frame(
  cca_prob  = predict(cca_svm$model,  newdata_full, type = "probabilities")[, levels(cca_svm$data$TYPE)[1]],
  rock_prob = predict(rock_svm$model, newdata_full, type = "probabilities")[, levels(rock_svm$data$TYPE)[1]],
  kelp_prob = predict(kelp_svm$model, newdata_full, type = "probabilities")[, levels(kelp_svm$data$TYPE)[1]]
)
stopifnot(nrow(urchin_prob_df) == nrow(habitat_model_data), !anyNA(urchin_prob_df))

urchin_pca <- prcomp(urchin_prob_df, scale. = TRUE)
print(summary(urchin_pca))
cat("\nRaw PC1 loadings (sign arbitrary):\n")
print(urchin_pca$rotation[, "PC1"])

oriented <- orient_pc1(urchin_pca, urchin_prob_df)
habitat_model_data$urchin_pc1 <- oriented$scores

cat("\nOriented PC1 loadings:\n")
print(oriented$rotation)

# HARD CHECK: higher PC1 must mean more urchin. If this fails, stop.
sign_check <- cor(habitat_model_data$urchin_pc1, urchin_prob_df$cca_prob)
cat("\ncor(urchin_pc1, cca_prob) =", round(sign_check, 4), "\n")
stopifnot(sign_check > 0.5)
```

```{r}
save_fixed_gtable <- function(filename, gtable_obj) {
  pdf(filename, 
      width = convertWidth(sum(gtable_obj$widths), "in", valueOnly = TRUE), 
      height = convertHeight(sum(gtable_obj$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE))
  grid.draw(gtable_obj)
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r}
library(egg)
library(cowplot)
library(ggtext)
library(grid)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. FORCE LOWERCASE ON ALL X-AXIS LABELS (TYPE PLOTS)
# ==============================================================================
lowercase_type_labels <- scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
  "Macrocystis Forest" = "<i>Macrocystis</i> forest",
  "Urchin Barren"      = "Urchin barren"
))

p_type       <- p_type       + lowercase_type_labels + theme(axis.text.x = element_markdown())
p_pc1_type   <- p_pc1_type   + lowercase_type_labels + theme(axis.text.x = element_markdown())
p_red_type   <- p_red_type   + lowercase_type_labels + theme(axis.text.x = element_markdown())
p_stipe_type <- p_stipe_type + lowercase_type_labels + theme(axis.text.x = element_markdown())

# Clean up titles and axis labels from individual site plots
p_site           <- p_site           + labs(title = NULL, x = NULL)
p_pc1_site_final <- p_pc1_site_final + labs(title = NULL, x = NULL)
p_red_site       <- p_red_site       + labs(title = NULL, x = NULL)
p_stipe_site     <- p_stipe_site     + labs(title = NULL, x = NULL)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. EXTRACT UNIFIED LEGEND WITH ITALICIZED MACROCYSTIS (HTML + MARKDOWN)
# ==============================================================================
# We swap the picky expression() call for a reliable HTML markdown string 
# and tell the legend text engine to parse it using element_markdown().
shared_legend <- get_legend(
  p_red_site + 
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Macrocystis Forest" = "#00BFC4", "Urchin Barren" = "#F8766D"),
      labels = c(
        "Macrocystis Forest" = "<i>Macrocystis</i> forest",
        "Urchin Barren"      = "Urchin barren"
      )
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position   = "bottom",
      legend.direction  = "horizontal",
      legend.text       = element_markdown() # Forces the HTML engine to parse the italics
    ) + 
    labs(fill = "Site type")
)


# Strip legends completely from ALL grid components before combining
p_type           <- p_type           + theme(legend.position = "none")
p_site           <- p_site           + theme(legend.position = "none")
p_pc1_type       <- p_pc1_type       + theme(legend.position = "none")
p_pc1_site_final <- p_pc1_site_final + theme(legend.position = "none")
p_red_type       <- p_red_type       + theme(legend.position = "none")
p_red_site       <- p_red_site       + theme(legend.position = "none")
p_stipe_type     <- p_stipe_type     + theme(legend.position = "none")
p_stipe_site     <- p_stipe_site     + theme(legend.position = "none")

# ==============================================================================
# 3. BUILD THE MULTI-PANEL GRID
# ==============================================================================
master_grid <- ggarrange(
  p_type,           p_site,
  p_pc1_type,       p_pc1_site_final,
  p_red_type,       p_red_site,
  p_stipe_type,     p_stipe_site,
  ncol = 2,
  byrow = TRUE,
  labels = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H"),
  label.args = list(gp = gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 14)),
  widths = c(3.2, 4.0)
)

# ==============================================================================
# 4. APPEND THE LOWERCASE SHARED LEGEND
# ==============================================================================
final_figure <- plot_grid(
  master_grid,
  shared_legend,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, 0.05)
)

# ==============================================================================
# 5. EXPORT MASTER COMPOSITION
# ==============================================================================
ggsave(
  filename = "Figure_2_Complete_Layout.pdf",
  plot     = final_figure,
  width    = 8.5,
  height   = 14.0,
  device   = "pdf"
)
```

```{r}
# How much of prob_barren do the SHARED predictors alone explain?
# If ~1, then ADI/AEI are inert and prob_barren ~ f(ACI, NDSI) — the same input
# space as urchin_pc1, and the correlation above is geometry, not ecology.
r2_shared <- summary(lm(prob_barren ~ ACI + NDSI, data = habitat_model_data))$r.squared
r2_all    <- summary(lm(prob_barren ~ ACI + NDSI + ADI + AEI,
                        data = habitat_model_data))$r.squared

cat("prob_barren ~ ACI + NDSI          : R2 =", round(r2_shared, 4), "\n")
cat("prob_barren ~ ACI + NDSI + ADI+AEI: R2 =", round(r2_all, 4), "\n")
cat("Extra explained by ADI/AEI        :   ", round(r2_all - r2_shared, 4), "\n\n")

# Stronger test: refit habitat SVM on ONLY the two features the urchin models
# never saw. If PC1 still tracks it, that's shared structure, not overlap.
habitat_svm_ae <- ksvm(TYPE ~ ADI + AEI, data = habitat_model_data,
                       kernel = SVM_KERNEL, kpar = list(sigma = SVM_SIGMA),
                       C = SVM_COST, prob.model = TRUE, scaled = TRUE)
prob_barren_ae <- predict(habitat_svm_ae, habitat_model_data,
                          type = "probabilities")[, BARREN_LABEL]

cat("cor(urchin_pc1, prob_barren)     [shares ACI+NDSI] =",
    round(cor(habitat_model_data$urchin_pc1, habitat_model_data$prob_barren), 4), "\n")
cat("cor(urchin_pc1, prob_barren_ae)  [shares nothing ] =",
    round(cor(habitat_model_data$urchin_pc1, prob_barren_ae), 4), "\n")
```

```{r}
make_tidal_panel <- function(hab_data, tide_df = noaa_tide, pc1_col = "urchin_pc1",
                             model_label = "SVM", keep_dates = PLOT_DATES,
                             span = 0.45, smooth_tide = TRUE) {

  agg <- hab_data %>%
    filter(DATE %in% keep_dates) %>%
    group_by(TYPE, DATE, HOUR) %>%
    summarise(value = mean(.data[[pc1_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
              se    = sd(.data[[pc1_col]], na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
              .groups = "drop")

  tide <- tide_df %>%
    mutate(DATE = as.Date(datetime, tz = SITE_TZ),
           HOUR = hour(datetime) + minute(datetime) / 60) %>%
    filter(DATE %in% keep_dates)

  # warn if the tide table doesn't cover every plotted date
  missing_dates <- setdiff(as.character(keep_dates), as.character(unique(tide$DATE)))
  if (length(missing_dates))
    warning("No tide data for: ", paste(missing_dates, collapse = ", "))

  # hourly points are coarse; spline to 10-min for a smooth curve
  tide_line <- if (smooth_tide) {
    tide %>%
      group_by(DATE) %>%
      group_modify(~ {
        s <- spline(.x$HOUR, .x$amplitude, n = 145)
        tibble(HOUR = s$x, amplitude = s$y)
      }) %>%
      ungroup()
  } else tide

  base <- list(
    facet_grid(. ~ DATE),
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 24), breaks = seq(0, 20, 5)),
    theme_bw(base_size = 11),
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(r = 4)))
  )
  no_x     <- theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
  no_strip <- theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_blank())

  one_panel <- function(type, colour, ylab, drop_x, drop_strip) {
    p <- ggplot(filter(agg, TYPE == type), aes(HOUR, value)) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = value - se, ymax = value + se),
                    width = 0, colour = colour, alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_point(colour = colour, size = 1.4) +
      geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = span, se = FALSE,
                  colour = colour, linewidth = 0.9) +
      base + labs(x = NULL, y = ylab)
    if (drop_x)     p <- p + no_x
    if (drop_strip) p <- p + no_strip
    p
  }

  p_forest <- one_panel(FOREST_LABEL, "#00BFC4", "Forest PC1", TRUE,  FALSE)
  p_barren <- one_panel(BARREN_LABEL, "#F8766D", "Barren PC1", FALSE, TRUE) +
    labs(x = "Hour (Sitka local)")

  p_tide <- ggplot(tide_line, aes(HOUR, amplitude)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(data = tide, size = 0.7, colour = "grey30") +   # actual NOAA hours
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey60") +
    base + no_x + no_strip +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Tide (ft MLLW)")

  p_forest / p_tide / p_barren +
    plot_annotation(
      title = paste0("Urchin acoustic activity, tidal cycle, and time of day (",
                     model_label, ")"),
      subtitle = "PC1 oriented so HIGHER = more urchin acoustics",
      caption = "Tide: NOAA harmonic predictions, Sitka station 9451600 (LST/LDT, MLLW)"
    )
}

make_tidal_panel(habitat_model_data)
```

```{r}
library(suncalc)

) %>%

print(sun_df[, c("DATE", "sunrise", "sunset")])   # sanity check the times

)

# --- aggregate acoustics and tide (same as make_tidal_panel) ---
agg <- habitat_model_data %>%
  filter(DATE %in% PLOT_DATES) %>%
  group_by(TYPE, DATE, HOUR) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(urchin_pc1, na.rm = TRUE),
            se    = sd(urchin_pc1, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")

  mutate(DATE = as.Date(datetime, tz = SITE_TZ),
         HOUR = hour(datetime) + minute(datetime) / 60) %>%
  filter(DATE %in% PLOT_DATES)

# --- shared layers ---
night_layer <- geom_rect(data = night_df,
                         aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),

base <- list(
  facet_grid(. ~ DATE),
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 24), breaks = seq(0, 20, 5)),

      panel.spacing.x = unit(0, "lines"))     
)
no_x     <- theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
no_strip <- theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_blank())

pc1_panel <- function(type, colour, ylab, drop_x, drop_strip) {
  p <- ggplot(filter(agg, TYPE == type), aes(HOUR, value)) +
    night_layer +                                    # night FIRST, sits behind
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = value - se, ymax = value + se),
                  width = 0, colour = colour, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_point(colour = colour, size = 1.4) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.45, se = FALSE,
                colour = colour, linewidth = 0.9) +
    base + labs(x = NULL, y = ylab)
  if (drop_x)     p <- p + no_x
  if (drop_strip) p <- p + no_strip
  p
}
```

### model with temp

Sea temp at 2.2m depth in sitka

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Path to your downloaded data file
file_path <- "/Users/aminashenasa/soundscapes_data/data/environmental_data/noaa_sea_temp.txt"

# 2. Define NOAA's structural columns
col_names <- c("YY", "MM", "DD", "hh", "mm", "WDIR", "WSPD", "GST", "WVHT", 
               "DPD", "APD", "MWD", "PRES", "ATMP", "WTMP", "DEWP", "VIS", "TIDE")

# 3. Read the file (skipping the double header lines)
raw_data <- read_table(file_path, skip = 2, col_names = col_names, col_types = cols(.default = "d"))

# 4. Filter for July 24 to July 27, 2025
july_data <- raw_data %>%
  filter(YY == 2025 & MM == 7 & DD %in% 24:27) %>%
  select(YY, MM, DD, hh, mm, WTMP) %>%
  
  # Clean up missing sensor values (99.0 or 999.0 means "no reading")
  mutate(WTMP = ifelse(WTMP >= 99.0, NA, WTMP)) %>%
  
  # Calculate Fahrenheit column
  mutate(WTMP_F = (WTMP * 1.8) + 32)

# 5. Print the filtered dataset
print(july_data)

```

```{r}
library(lubridate)

july_data <- raw_data %>% 
  # Include July 28 to capture the shifted UTC hours
  filter(YY == 2025 & MM == 7 & DD %in% 24:28) %>% 
  select(YY, MM, DD, hh, mm, WTMP) %>% 
  mutate(
    WTMP = ifelse(WTMP >= 99.0, NA, WTMP),
    WTMP_F = (WTMP * 1.8) + 32, 
    datetime_utc = make_datetime(YY, MM, DD, hh, mm, tz = "UTC"), 
    datetime_local = with_tz(datetime_utc, tzone = "America/Sitka")
```

```{r}
temp_df <- final_soundscape_data %>%
  mutate(DATE = as.Date(DateTime_Local),
         HOUR = hour(DateTime_Local) + minute(DateTime_Local) / 60) %>%
  filter(DATE %in% PLOT_DATES)

# --- label helper: main title + smaller grey qualifier (matches emmeans figure) ---
ax_lab <- function(main, hint = NULL) {
  if (is.null(hint)) return(main)
  paste0(main, "<br><span style='font-size:10pt; color:grey40'>", hint, "</span>")
}

# --- shared layers ---
night_layer <- geom_rect(data = night_df,
                         aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
                         fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE)

base <- list(
  facet_grid(. ~ DATE),
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 24), breaks = seq(0, 20, 5)),
  theme_urchin()
)
no_x     <- theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                  axis.title.x = element_blank())
no_strip <- theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_blank())

# same size/spacing on every axis title
lab_theme <- theme(
  axis.title.x = element_markdown(size = 12, lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(t = 8)),
  axis.title.y = element_markdown(size = 12, lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(r = 8))
)

# --- PC1 panel ---
p_pc1_combined <- ggplot(agg_pc1_combined, aes(HOUR, value, colour = TYPE)) +
  night_layer +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = value - se, ymax = value + se),
                width = 0, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.45, se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = "Habitat Type",
    values = c("Barren" = "#F8766D", "Macro_Forest" = "#00BFC4"),
    labels = hab_labs, drop = FALSE
  ) +
  base + no_x +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = ax_lab("Sea urchin activity PC1", "(low noise \u2192 high noise)")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") + lab_theme + no_x

# --- tide panel ---
p_tide <- ggplot(tide, aes(HOUR, amplitude)) +
  night_layer +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  base + no_x + no_strip +
  labs(x = NULL, y = ax_lab("Tide", "(ft MLLW)")) +
  lab_theme + no_x

# --- temperature panel ---
p_temp <- ggplot(temp_df, aes(HOUR, WTMP_F)) +
  night_layer +
  geom_line(color = "magenta2", linewidth = 0.8) +
  base + no_strip +
  labs(x = "Hour (Sitka local)",
       y = ax_lab("Sea temperature", "(\u00B0F, 2.2 m depth)")) +
  lab_theme

# --- stack ---
p_tidal_night_pc1_combined <- p_pc1_combined / p_tide / p_temp +
  plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Urchin acoustic activity (both habitats), tidal cycle, water temperature, and time of day",
    caption = "Grey shading marks night."
  )

p_tidal_night_pc1_combined
ggsave("tidal_panel_night_pc1_combined.png", p_tidal_night_pc1_combined,
       width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 600, device = ragg::agg_png)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12

library(suncalc)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(lubridate)
library(ggtext)

SITKA_LAT <- 57.0531
SITKA_LON <- -135.3309

# --- night bands ---
sun_df <- getSunlightTimes(
  date = PLOT_DATES, lat = SITKA_LAT, lon = SITKA_LON,
  keep = c("sunrise", "sunset"), tz = SITE_TZ
) %>%
  mutate(DATE    = as.Date(date),
         sr_hour = hour(sunrise) + minute(sunrise) / 60,
         ss_hour = hour(sunset)  + minute(sunset)  / 60)

night_df <- bind_rows(
  transmute(sun_df, DATE, xmin = 0,       xmax = sr_hour),
  transmute(sun_df, DATE, xmin = ss_hour, xmax = 24)
)

# --- aggregate acoustics and tide ---
agg_pc1_combined <- habitat_model_data %>%
  filter(DATE %in% PLOT_DATES) %>%
  group_by(TYPE, DATE, HOUR) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(urchin_pc1, na.rm = TRUE),
            se    = sd(urchin_pc1, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")

agg_pc1_combined <- agg_pc1_combined %>% mutate(HOUR = HOUR + 0.5)

tide <- noaa_tide %>%
  mutate(DATE = as.Date(datetime, tz = SITE_TZ),
         HOUR = hour(datetime) + minute(datetime) / 60) %>%
  filter(DATE %in% PLOT_DATES)

temp_df <- final_soundscape_data %>%
  mutate(DATE = as.Date(DateTime_Local),
         HOUR = hour(DateTime_Local) + minute(DateTime_Local) / 60) %>%
  filter(DATE %in% PLOT_DATES)

# --- label helper: main title + smaller grey qualifier (matches emmeans figure) ---
ax_lab <- function(main, hint = NULL) {
  if (is.null(hint)) return(main)
  paste0(main, "<br><span style='font-size:10pt; color:grey40'>", hint, "</span>")
}

# --- shared layers ---
night_layer <- geom_rect(data = night_df,
                         aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
                         fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE)

base <- list(
  facet_grid(. ~ DATE, labeller = labeller(DATE = function(x) format(as.Date(x), "%b %d"))),
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 24), breaks = seq(0, 20, 5),
                     expand = c(0, 0)),
  theme_urchin(),
  theme(panel.spacing.x = unit(0, "pt"))
)
no_x     <- theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                  axis.title.x = element_blank())
no_strip <- theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_blank())

# same size/spacing on every axis title
lab_theme <- theme(
  axis.title.x = element_markdown(size = 12, lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(t = 8)),
  axis.title.y = element_markdown(size = 12, lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(r = 8))
)

# --- PC1 panel ---
p_pc1_combined <- ggplot(agg_pc1_combined,
                         aes(HOUR, value, colour = TYPE, fill = TYPE)) +
  night_layer +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +

  # Option A: remove the error bars entirely (matches emmeans most closely)
  # (just delete the geom_errorbar line)

  # Option B: keep them, but faded
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = value - se, ymax = value + se),
                width = 0, alpha = 0.3) +

  geom_point(size = 1.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.45, se = TRUE, level = 0.95,
              linewidth = 1,        # matches emmeans line width
              alpha = 0.15) +       # matches emmeans ribbon alpha
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Habitat Type",
                      values = c("Barren" = "#F8766D", "Macro_Forest" = "#00BFC4"),
                      labels = hab_labs, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Habitat Type",
                    values = c("Barren" = "#F8766D", "Macro_Forest" = "#00BFC4"),
                    labels = hab_labs, drop = FALSE) +
  base + no_x +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = ax_lab("Sea urchin activity PC1", "(low noise \u2192 high noise)")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") + lab_theme + no_x
# --- tide panel ---
p_tide <- ggplot(tide, aes(HOUR, amplitude)) +
  night_layer +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  base + no_x + no_strip +
  labs(x = NULL, y = ax_lab("Tide", "(ft MLLW)")) +
  lab_theme + no_x

# --- temperature panel ---
p_temp <- ggplot(temp_df, aes(HOUR, WTMP_F)) +
  night_layer +
  geom_line(color = "magenta2", linewidth = 0.8) +
  base + no_strip +
  labs(x = "Hour (Sitka local)",
       y = ax_lab("Sea temperature", "(\u00B0F, 2.2 m depth)")) +
  lab_theme

# --- stack ---
p_tidal_night_pc1_combined <- p_pc1_combined / p_tide / p_temp +
  plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Urchin acoustic activity (both habitats), tidal cycle, water temperature, and time of day",
```

```{r}
# ---- 1. Build combined_df with all derived time columns ----
combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  arrange(TYPE, site, DATE, HOUR) %>%
  group_by(TYPE, site) %>%
  mutate(day_index = as.integer(factor(DATE)) - 1,
         hour_continuous = HOUR + day_index * 24) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    hour_factor = factor(hour_continuous, ordered = TRUE),
    site = factor(site)
  )

  filter(!is.na(WTMP_F))

# ---- 3. PCA on tide + temperature ----

  select(tide, WTMP_F) %>%

summary(tide_temp_pca)      # variance explained by PC1
tide_temp_pca$rotation      # loadings -- confirm PC1 direction/sign

combined_df_temp <- combined_df_temp %>%
  filter(complete.cases(tide, WTMP_F)) %>%
  mutate(tide_temp_pc1 = tide_temp_pca$x[, "PC1"])
```

### comparing 3 model packages

```{r}
library(nlme)
library(glmmTMB)
library(broom.mixed)   

# shared formula
# value ~ tide_temp_pc1 * elevation * TYPE
# AR1 correlation by hour_continuous, grouped by site


# 1. GLS — fixed effects only, AR1 as residual correlation
#    (no site-level random effect)
m_gls <- gls(
  value ~ tide_temp_pc1 * elevation * TYPE,
  correlation = corAR1(form = ~ hour_continuous | site),
  data = combined_df_temp
)

summary(m_gls)
anova(m_gls)

# 2. LME — fixed effects + random intercept for site,
#    AR1 as residual correlation (same corAR1 structure as gls)
m_lme <- lme(
  value ~ tide_temp_pc1 * elevation * TYPE,
  random = ~ 1 | site,
  correlation = corAR1(form = ~ hour_continuous | site),
  data = combined_df_temp
)

summary(m_lme)
anova(m_lme, type = "marginal")
VarCorr(m_lme)

# 3. glmmTMB — fixed effects + AR1 as a random-effect covariance
#    structure (requires factor time variable; NOT equivalent to corAR1 above — kept here only for comparison/diagnostics)

combined_df_temp <- combined_df_temp %>%
  mutate(
    hour_factor = factor(hour_continuous, ordered = TRUE),
    site = factor(site)
  )

m_glmmtmb <- glmmTMB(
  value ~ tide_temp_pc1 * elevation * TYPE + (1 | site) +
    ar1(hour_factor + 0 | site),
  data = combined_df_temp
)

summary(m_glmmtmb)
car::Anova(m_glmmtmb, type = "III")
performance::check_singularity(m_glmmtmb)   # expect TRUE — flags the degenerate fit

# comparison of fixed effect estimates
library(broom.mixed)

coef_compare <- bind_rows(
  tidy(m_gls)     %>% mutate(model = "gls (AR1 only)"),
  tidy(m_lme, effects = "fixed") %>% mutate(model = "lme (site RI + AR1)"),
  tidy(m_glmmtmb, effects = "fixed") %>% mutate(model = "glmmTMB (AR1 as RE, singular)")
) %>%
  select(model, term, estimate, std.error, p.value)

print(coef_compare, n = 30)


# AIC/BIC comparison (only valid to compare gls vs lme directly;
# glmmTMB uses a different likelihood structure so treat its AIC cautiously given the singular fit)

AIC(m_gls, m_lme)
BIC(m_gls, m_lme)
```

```{r}
combined_df_temp <- combined_df_temp %>%
  mutate(
    hour_factor = factor(hour_continuous, ordered = TRUE),
    site = factor(site)
  )

m_glmmtmb <- glmmTMB(
  value ~ tide_temp_pc1 * elevation * TYPE + (1 | site),
  type 3 sum of squares
  REML = TRUE, 
  data = combined_df_temp
)

summary(m_glmmtmb)
car::Anova(m_glmmtmb, type = "III")
performance::check_singularity(m_glmmtmb)   
```

```{r}
m_lme <- lme(
  value ~ tide_temp_pc1 * elevation * TYPE,
  random = ~ 1 | site,
  correlation = corAR1(form = ~ hour_continuous | site),
  data = combined_df_temp
)

summary(m_lme)
anova(m_lme, type = "marginal")   #type 3 equivalent
VarCorr(m_lme)
```

```{r}
library(emmeans)

elev_vals <- c(-13.598, 2.924, 19.446, 35.967, 52.489)
tide_vals <- seq(0, 10, by = 0.5)   # fine grid for a smooth ribbon

rg <- ref_grid(m_gls_final,
                at = list(tide = tide_vals, elevation = elev_vals),
                cov.reduce = FALSE)

preds <- as.data.frame(emmeans(rg, ~ tide * elevation * TYPE))

                               levels = elev_vals,

p_emmeans <- ggplot(preds, aes(x = tide, y = emmean, color = TYPE, fill = TYPE)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ elevation_lab, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 5, 10)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Habitat Type", values = hab_cols, labels = hab_labs) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Habitat Type", values = hab_cols, labels = hab_labs) +
  labs(x = "Tide (ft MLLW)", y = "Sea Urchin PC1 (predicted)") +
  theme_urchin()
```

```{r}
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Pick three elevation reference points spanning your data
elev_low  <- -13.598
elev_mid  <- 19.446
elev_high <- 52.489

tide_seq <- seq(min(combined_df$tide), max(combined_df$tide), length.out = 30)

# Helper to build predictions at a given elevation, varying tide x TYPE
get_profile <- function(elev_val, elev_label) {
  rg <- ref_grid(m_gls_final,
                  at = list(tide = tide_seq, elevation = elev_val))
  df <- as.data.frame(emmeans(rg, ~ tide * TYPE))
  df$elev_label <- elev_label
  df
}

df_low  <- get_profile(elev_low,  "Elevation = -13.6 (low)")
df_mid  <- get_profile(elev_mid,  "Elevation = 19.4 (mid)")
df_high <- get_profile(elev_high, "Elevation = 52.5 (high)")

df_all <- bind_rows(df_low, df_mid, df_high)
df_all$elev_label <- factor(df_all$elev_label,
                             levels = c("Elevation = -13.6 (low)",
                                        "Elevation = 19.4 (mid)",
                                        "Elevation = 52.5 (high)"))

ggplot(df_all, aes(x = tide, y = emmean, color = TYPE, fill = TYPE)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ elev_label, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Barren" = "#F8766D", "Macro_Forest" = "#00BFC4")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Barren" = "#F8766D", "Macro_Forest" = "#00BFC4")) +
  labs(y = "pc1 (predicted)", x = "tide",
       title = "Tide × type interaction, shown across elevation") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

```{r}
library(emmeans)

# --- Panel A: tide effect, by TYPE (holding elevation fixed at mean) ---

pA <- ggplot(df_tide, aes(x = tide, y = emmean, color = TYPE, fill = TYPE)) +
```

```{r}
# 1. Did the earlier stat use a different agg object, or a filtered/subsetted one?
#    Look for any earlier code that created a *different* summary object 
#    (e.g. one that averaged over site first) before computing the original r = -0.76

# 2. Check for NAs being dropped differently between runs
agg %>% filter(TYPE == "Barren") %>% summarise(n = n(), n_na_value = sum(is.na(value)))
tide_hourly %>% summarise(n = n(), n_na_tide = sum(is.na(tide)))

# 3. Confirm the join isn't producing duplicate or mismatched rows
agg %>% filter(TYPE == "Barren") %>% inner_join(tide_hourly, by = c("DATE","HOUR")) %>% 
  count(site) # should be 96 per site if 1:1 match

# 4. Compare this rerun's habitat-level r against a manual recompute using an 
#    explicit site-mean-first approach, to see if THAT reproduces -0.76:
agg %>%
  filter(TYPE == "Barren") %>%
  group_by(DATE, HOUR) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  inner_join(tide_hourly, by = c("DATE","HOUR")) %>%
  summarise(r = cor(value, tide), r2 = cor(value, tide)^2)
```

```{r}
  mutate(elevation = getSunlightPosition(date = datetime,
```

```{r}
# --- Pooled habitat-level ---

  inner_join(sun_elevation, by = c("DATE", "HOUR")) %>%
  group_by(TYPE) %>%
  summarise(r  = cor(value, elevation),
            r2 = cor(value, elevation)^2,
            n  = n(),
            .groups = "drop")
print(pc1_sun_stats_habitat)

# --- Per-site ---
pc1_sun_stats_site <- agg %>%
  inner_join(sun_elevation, by = c("DATE", "HOUR")) %>%
  group_by(TYPE, site) %>%
  summarise(r  = cor(value, elevation),
            r2 = cor(value, elevation)^2,
            n  = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(TYPE, desc(r2))
print(pc1_sun_stats_site)

# --- Site-averaged-first (matches your original tide r = -0.76 method) ---

  group_by(TYPE, DATE, HOUR) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  inner_join(sun_elevation, by = c("DATE", "HOUR")) %>%
  group_by(TYPE) %>%
  summarise(r = cor(value, elevation), r2 = cor(value, elevation)^2)
print(pc1_sun_stats_habitat_avgfirst)
```

```{r}
solar_noon_lookup <- agg %>%
  distinct(DATE) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(DATE)) %>%
  { getSunlightTimes(date = .$date, lat = SITKA_LAT, lon = SITKA_LON,
                      keep = "solarNoon", tz = "America/Sitka") } %>%
  select(DATE = date, solarNoon)

sun_elevation <- agg %>%
  distinct(DATE, HOUR) %>%
  mutate(datetime = as.POSIXct(paste(DATE, sprintf("%02d:30:00", HOUR)),
                                tz = "America/Sitka")) %>%
  mutate(
    elevation = getSunlightPosition(date = datetime, lat = SITKA_LAT, lon = SITKA_LON)$altitude * 180/pi,
    azimuth   = getSunlightPosition(date = datetime, lat = SITKA_LAT, lon = SITKA_LON)$azimuth * 180/pi
  ) %>%
  left_join(solar_noon_lookup, by = "DATE") %>%
  mutate(hours_from_solar_noon = as.numeric(difftime(datetime, solarNoon, units = "hours"))) %>%
  select(DATE, HOUR, elevation, azimuth, hours_from_solar_noon)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)

## ---------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. Simple correlations (tide and elevation), 
##    pooled / site-averaged / per-site
## ---------------------------------------------------------------

make_cor_row <- function(df, group_vars, var, method_label) {
  df %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
    summarise(
      predictor = var,
      r  = cor(value, .data[[var]]),
      r2 = cor(value, .data[[var]])^2,
      n  = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(method = method_label)
}

# join tide + elevation once
combined_df <- agg %>%
  inner_join(tide_hourly, by = c("DATE", "HOUR")) %>%
  inner_join(sun_elevation, by = c("DATE", "HOUR"))

site_avg_df <- agg %>%
  group_by(TYPE, DATE, HOUR) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  inner_join(tide_hourly, by = c("DATE", "HOUR")) %>%
  inner_join(sun_elevation, by = c("DATE", "HOUR"))

cor_pooled_tide      <- make_cor_row(combined_df, "TYPE", "tide", "pooled")
cor_pooled_elev      <- make_cor_row(combined_df, "TYPE", "elevation", "pooled")
cor_siteavg_tide     <- make_cor_row(site_avg_df, "TYPE", "tide", "site_averaged")
cor_siteavg_elev     <- make_cor_row(site_avg_df, "TYPE", "elevation", "site_averaged")
cor_persite_tide     <- make_cor_row(combined_df, c("TYPE","site"), "tide", "per_site")
cor_persite_elev     <- make_cor_row(combined_df, c("TYPE","site"), "elevation", "per_site")

cor_table <- bind_rows(
  cor_pooled_tide, cor_pooled_elev,
  cor_siteavg_tide, cor_siteavg_elev,
  cor_persite_tide, cor_persite_elev
) %>%
  relocate(method, predictor, TYPE, any_of("site"), r, r2, n) %>%
  mutate(across(c(r, r2), ~round(.x, 3)))

## ---------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. Combined multiple regression (tide + elevation),
##    pooled habitat / site-averaged habitat / per-site
## ---------------------------------------------------------------

fit_combined_lm <- function(df, group_vars, method_label) {
  df %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      m <- lm(value ~ tide + elevation, data = .x)
      tidy(m) %>%
        select(term, estimate, std.error, p.value) %>%
        mutate(r2 = summary(m)$r.squared, n = nobs(m))
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(method = method_label)
}

lm_pooled_habitat  <- fit_combined_lm(combined_df, "TYPE", "pooled")
lm_siteavg_habitat <- fit_combined_lm(site_avg_df, "TYPE", "site_averaged")
lm_persite          <- fit_combined_lm(combined_df, c("TYPE","site"), "per_site")

lm_table <- bind_rows(lm_pooled_habitat, lm_siteavg_habitat, lm_persite) %>%
  relocate(method, TYPE, any_of("site"), term, estimate, std.error, p.value, r2, n) %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, std.error, r2), ~round(.x, 4)),
         p.value = signif(p.value, 3))

## ---------------------------------------------------------------
## 3. View / export
## ---------------------------------------------------------------

print(cor_table, n = Inf)
print(lm_table, n = Inf)

write.csv(cor_table, "correlation_summary_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(lm_table, "combined_model_summary_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Step 1 — predict all three urchin SVMs onto full habitat_model_data
cca_probs_full  <- predict(cca_urchin_svm_model,  newdata = data.frame(
                              ACI  = habitat_model_data$ACI,
                              NDSI = habitat_model_data$NDSI), 
                            type = "probabilities")[, "URCHIN_CCA"]

rock_probs_full <- predict(rock_urchin_svm_model, newdata = data.frame(
                              ACI  = as.numeric(habitat_model_data$ACI),
                              NDSI = as.numeric(habitat_model_data$NDSI)),
                            type = "probabilities")[, "URCHINS_BARE_ROCK"]

kelp_probs_full <- predict(kelp_urchin_svm_model, newdata = data.frame(
                              ACI  = habitat_model_data$ACI,
                              NDSI = habitat_model_data$NDSI),
                            type = "probabilities")[, "URCHIN_KELP"]

# Step 2 — combine into one dataframe and run PCA
urchin_prob_df <- data.frame(
  cca_prob  = cca_probs_full,
  rock_prob = rock_probs_full,
  kelp_prob = kelp_probs_full
)

urchin_pca  <- prcomp(urchin_prob_df, scale. = TRUE)
summary(urchin_pca)

# Step 3 — extract PC1 
pc1_scores <- -urchin_pca$x[, "PC1"]

# Step 4 — get habitat SVM probabilities for full model_data
habitat_probs <- predict(habitat_svm_model, newdata = habitat_model_data, type = "probabilities")
prob_barren_all <- habitat_probs[, "Barren"]

# Step 5 — regress and plot
pc1_df <- data.frame(
  pc1         = pc1_scores,
  prob_barren = prob_barren_all
)

lm_pc1 <- lm(prob_barren ~ pc1, data = pc1_df)
summary(lm_pc1)

# Plot
ggplot(pc1_df, aes(x = pc1, y = prob_barren)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "steelblue", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text",
           x     = min(pc1_df$pc1),
           y     = max(pc1_df$prob_barren),
           label = paste0("R² = ", round(summary(lm_pc1)$r.squared, 3),
                          ", P = ", format(summary(lm_pc1)$coefficients[2, 4],
                                           scientific = TRUE, digits = 2)),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 4.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "More Urchin Noise (PC1)",
    y = "Probability of Assignment as Urchin Barrens (SVM)"
  ) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
# One helper for both the prob_barren and PC1 versions.
make_eco_panel <- function(site_df, yvar, ylab, title) {

  long <- site_df %>%
    select(site, true_type, all_of(yvar), all_of(names(ECO_VARS))) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(names(ECO_VARS)),
                 names_to = "variable", values_to = "eco_value") %>%
    rename(yval = all_of(yvar)) %>%
    mutate(variable = factor(ECO_VARS[variable], levels = ECO_VARS)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(eco_value), !is.na(yval))

  stats <- long %>%
    group_by(variable) %>%
    summarise(
      r2  = summary(lm(yval ~ eco_value))$r.squared,
      p   = summary(lm(yval ~ eco_value))$coefficients[2, 4],
      rho = suppressWarnings(cor(eco_value, yval, method = "spearman")),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(label = sprintf("R\u00B2 = %.3f, p = %.3f\n\u03C1 = %.2f", r2, p, rho))

  ggplot(long, aes(eco_value, yval)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "black", fill = "grey85") +
    geom_point(aes(colour = true_type), size = 3) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = site, colour = true_type), size = 3,
                    show.legend = FALSE, seed = 1, max.overlaps = Inf,
                    box.padding = 0.5) +
    geom_text(data = stats, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
              hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.2, size = 3.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Barren = "#F8766D", Macro_Forest = "#00BFC4"),
                        name = "Habitat") +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = "n = 6 sites",
         x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

```{r}
run_stepwise <- function(response, data = site_data) {
  null_model <- lm(as.formula(paste(response, "~ 1")), data = data)
  full_model <- lm(as.formula(paste(response, "~ red_urchin_density +",
                                    "red_urchin_biomass + green_urchin_density +",
                                    "stipe_density")), data = data)
  step_model <- step(null_model,
                     scope     = list(lower = null_model, upper = full_model),
                     direction = "forward",
                     k         = log(nrow(data)),
                     trace     = 0)

  print(summary(step_model))
  cat("Adjusted R2:", round(summary(step_model)$adj.r.squared, 4), "\n")
  cat("Terms retained:",
      paste(attr(terms(step_model), "term.labels"), collapse = " + "), "\n")
  invisible(step_model)
}

step_prob <- run_stepwise("mean_prob")
step_pc1  <- run_stepwise("mean_pc1")
```

# Urchin push w*/* 5 second clips

```{r}
start_local <- min(habitat_model_data$dt_local, na.rm = TRUE)
end_local   <- max(habitat_model_data$dt_local, na.rm = TRUE)
c(start_local, end_local)   # expect 2025-07-23 15:59:43 -> 2025-07-28 15:59:32 AKDT
```

```{r}

library(dplyr); library(lubridate)

SITE_TZ <- "America/Sitka"

start_local <- min(habitat_model_data$dt_local, na.rm = TRUE)
end_local   <- max(habitat_model_data$dt_local, na.rm = TRUE)
c(start_local, end_local)

read_5s <- function(path) {
  df <- read.csv(path, check.names = TRUE)

  dt_utc <- as.POSIXct(paste(df$DATE..UTC., df$TIME..UTC.),
                       format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")
  stopifnot(!anyNA(dt_utc))                    # hard stop if parsing fails

  df %>%
    mutate(dt_utc     = dt_utc,
           dt_local   = with_tz(dt_utc, SITE_TZ),
           minute_bin = floor_date(dt_local, "minute"),
           DATE       = as.Date(dt_local, tz = SITE_TZ),
           HOUR       = hour(dt_local))
}

fine_batt <- read_5s("~/soundscapes_data/data/acoustic_data/5-sec-indices/5_battery_island_hydromoth_0.csv")
fine_sams <- read_5s("~/soundscapes_data/data/acoustic_data/5-sec-indices/5_samsing_cove_hydromoth_6.csv")



# systematic pick: FIRST clip of each minute
subsample_1min <- function(df) {
  df %>% arrange(dt_local) %>% group_by(minute_bin) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup()
}

sub_batt <- subsample_1min(fine_batt)   # 8,609 before windowing
sub_sams <- subsample_1min(fine_sams)   # 8,836 before windowing

# --- TRIM to the same window as the 60s analysis --------------------------
# The 5s files over-run the shared window: Battery starts ~1 day early,
# Samsing ends ~1 day late. Both trim to exactly 7,201 minutes.
fine_5s <- bind_rows(sub_batt, sub_sams) %>%
  filter(dt_local >= start_local, dt_local <= end_local)

fine_5s %>% count(SITE) %>% print()     # expect 7,201 each
print(range(fine_5s$dt_local))
stopifnot(all(count(fine_5s, SITE)$n == 7200))


# 2. SCORE THROUGH THE EXISTING SVMs  (ACI + NDSI only)

newdata_5s <- data.frame(ACI  = as.numeric(fine_5s$ACI),
                         NDSI = as.numeric(fine_5s$NDSI))
stopifnot(!anyNA(newdata_5s))

probs_5s <- data.frame(
  cca_prob  = predict(cca_svm$model,  newdata_5s, type = "probabilities")[, levels(cca_svm$data$TYPE)[1]],
  rock_prob = predict(rock_svm$model, newdata_5s, type = "probabilities")[, levels(rock_svm$data$TYPE)[1]],
  kelp_prob = predict(kelp_svm$model, newdata_5s, type = "probabilities")[, levels(kelp_svm$data$TYPE)[1]]
)
stopifnot(nrow(probs_5s) == nrow(fine_5s), !anyNA(probs_5s))


# 3. PROJECT THROUGH THE EXISTING PCA  (no refit -- scores stay comparable)

raw_pc1  <- predict(urchin_pca, urchin_prob_df)[, 1]
PC1_SIGN <- sign(cor(raw_pc1, habitat_model_data$urchin_pc1))
stopifnot(abs(cor(raw_pc1 * PC1_SIGN, habitat_model_data$urchin_pc1) - 1) < 1e-8)

fine_5s <- bind_cols(fine_5s, probs_5s)
fine_5s$urchin_pc1 <- predict(urchin_pca, probs_5s)[, 1] * PC1_SIGN

sc <- cor(fine_5s$urchin_pc1, fine_5s$cca_prob)
cat("cor(urchin_pc1, cca_prob) =", round(sc, 4), "\n")
stopifnot(sc > 0.5)

# 4. DOES CLIP LENGTH CHANGE THE PICTURE?  5s vs 60s, same sites

bind_rows(
  fine_5s %>% transmute(dur = "5s", SITE, NDSI, ACI, urchin_pc1),
  habitat_model_data %>%
    filter(SITE %in% unique(fine_5s$SITE)) %>%
    transmute(dur = "60s", SITE, NDSI, ACI, urchin_pc1)
) %>%
  group_by(SITE, dur) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            ndsi_mean = mean(NDSI),   ndsi_sd = sd(NDSI),
            pc1_mean  = mean(urchin_pc1), pc1_sd = sd(urchin_pc1),
            pc1_p10   = quantile(urchin_pc1, 0.10),
            pc1_p90   = quantile(urchin_pc1, 0.90),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  print(width = Inf)
```

```{r}
fit_urchin_svm_condensed <- function(raw, urchin_label, absent_label,
                                     present_out, absent_out, seed = 123) {

  raw <- raw[trimws(raw$TYPE) %in% c(urchin_label, absent_label), ]

  clean <- data.frame(
    TYPE = ifelse(trimws(raw$TYPE) == urchin_label, present_out, absent_out),
    ACI  = as.numeric(raw$ACI),
    NDSI = as.numeric(raw$NDSI)
  )
  clean <- na.omit(clean)
  clean$TYPE <- factor(clean$TYPE, levels = c(present_out, absent_out))

  if (any(table(clean$TYPE) == 0)) {
    stop("A class had zero rows for '", present_out,
         "' — check the exact TYPE strings.")
  }

  cat("\n===", present_out, "===\n")
  print(table(clean$TYPE))

  model <- ksvm(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = clean,
                kernel = SVM_KERNEL, kpar = list(sigma = SVM_SIGMA),
                C = SVM_COST, prob.model = TRUE, scaled = TRUE)

  cat("Kernel: RBF | C =", SVM_COST, "| sigma =", SVM_SIGMA, "\n")
  cat("Support vectors:", model@nSV, "of", nrow(clean),
      sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", 100 * model@nSV / nrow(clean)))

  pred      <- predict(model, newdata = clean)
  conf_mat  <- table(Actual = clean$TYPE, Predicted = pred)
  misclass  <- 1 - sum(diag(conf_mat)) / sum(conf_mat)

  print(conf_mat)
  cat("Misclassification rate:", round(misclass, 7), "\n")

  set.seed(seed)
  cv <- ksvm(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI, data = clean,
             kernel = SVM_KERNEL, kpar = list(sigma = SVM_SIGMA),
             C = SVM_COST, cross = 5, scaled = TRUE)
  cat("5-fold CV accuracy:", round(1 - cross(cv), 7), "\n")

  list(model = model, data = clean, conf_mat = conf_mat,
       misclass = misclass, cv_error = cross(cv))
}
```

```{r}
make_urchin_profile_condensed <- function(fit, title) {
  g <- expand.grid(
    ACI  = seq(min(fit$data$ACI),  max(fit$data$ACI),  length.out = 200),
    NDSI = seq(min(fit$data$NDSI), max(fit$data$NDSI), length.out = 200)
  )
  g$pred_class <- predict(fit$model, newdata = g)

  lv <- levels(fit$data$TYPE)
  ggplot(g, aes(NDSI, ACI, fill = pred_class)) +
    geom_raster(interpolate = TRUE, alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_point(data = fit$data, aes(NDSI, ACI, shape = TYPE),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#F4CCCC", "#C9DAF8"), lv),
                      name = "Predicted") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = setNames(c(16, 17), lv), name = "Actual") +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)
}

make_urchin_profile_condensed(cca_svm_condensed,  "CCA")
make_urchin_profile_condensed(rock_svm_condensed, "Bare rock")
```

```{r}

orient_pc1_condensed <- function(pca, prob_df) {
  scores      <- pca$x[, "PC1"]
  mean_urchin <- rowMeans(prob_df)
  if (cor(scores, mean_urchin) < 0) {
    scores                <- -scores
    pca$rotation[, "PC1"] <- -pca$rotation[, "PC1"]
  }
  list(scores = scores, rotation = pca$rotation[, "PC1"])
}
```

```{r}
if (!exists("eco_data")) {
  eco_data <- read.csv(PATH_ECO) %>%
    rename(
      red_urchin_biomass   = `Mean.Mean.Red.Urchin.Biomass...m2.`,
      stipe_density        = `Mean.Mean.Stipe.Density..m.2..`,
      red_urchin_density   = `Mean.Strongylocentrotus.franciscanus..red.urchin.m.2.`,
      green_urchin_density = `Mean.Strongylocentrotus..green.urchin.m.2.`
    ) %>%
    mutate(join_key = tolower(SITE))
}

ECO_VARS <- c(red_urchin_density   = "Red urchin density (m\u00B2)",
              red_urchin_biomass   = "Red urchin biomass (m\u00B2)",
              green_urchin_density = "Green urchin density (m\u00B2)",
              stipe_density        = "Macrocystis stipe density (m\u00B2)")

# Per-site summary using the CONDENSED PC1. mean_prob (habitat SVM) is
# unchanged since prob_barren doesn't depend on the urchin PCA.
site_data_condensed <- habitat_model_data %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(mean_prob = mean(prob_barren, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_pc1  = mean(urchin_pc1_condensed, na.rm = TRUE),   # <- condensed
            true_type = first(TYPE),
            n_obs     = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(join_key = tolower(site)) %>%
  left_join(eco_data, by = "join_key")

if (anyNA(site_data_condensed$red_urchin_density)) {
  warning("Join left NAs in red_urchin_density. Site keys:\n",
          paste(setdiff(site_data_condensed$join_key, eco_data$join_key),
                collapse = ", "))
}
print(site_data_condensed[, c("site", "true_type", "mean_prob", "mean_pc1",
                              "red_urchin_density")])
```

```{r}
r2_all    <- summary(lm(prob_barren ~ ACI + NDSI + ADI + AEI,
                        data = habitat_model_data))$r.squared

cat("prob_barren ~ ACI + NDSI + ADI+AEI: R2 =", round(r2_all, 4), "\n")
cat("Extra explained by ADI/AEI        :   ", round(r2_all - r2_shared, 4), "\n\n")

habitat_svm_ae_condensed <- ksvm(TYPE ~ ADI + AEI, data = habitat_model_data,
                                 kernel = SVM_KERNEL, kpar = list(sigma = SVM_SIGMA),
                                 C = SVM_COST, prob.model = TRUE, scaled = TRUE)
prob_barren_ae_condensed <- predict(habitat_svm_ae_condensed, habitat_model_data,
                                    type = "probabilities")[, BARREN_LABEL]

cat("cor(urchin_pc1_condensed, prob_barren)    [shares ACI+NDSI] =",
    round(cor(habitat_model_data$urchin_pc1_condensed,
              habitat_model_data$prob_barren), 4), "\n")
cat("cor(urchin_pc1_condensed, prob_barren_ae) [shares nothing ] =",
    round(cor(habitat_model_data$urchin_pc1_condensed,
              prob_barren_ae_condensed), 4), "\n")
```

### Eco panel helper

```{r}

library(ggrepel)

make_eco_panel <- function(site_df, yvar, ylab, title) {
  long <- site_df %>%
    select(site, true_type, all_of(yvar), all_of(names(ECO_VARS))) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(names(ECO_VARS)),
                 names_to = "variable", values_to = "eco_value") %>%
    rename(yval = all_of(yvar)) %>%
    mutate(variable = factor(ECO_VARS[variable], levels = ECO_VARS)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(eco_value), !is.na(yval))

  stats <- long %>%
    group_by(variable) %>%
    summarise(
      r2  = summary(lm(yval ~ eco_value))$r.squared,
      p   = summary(lm(yval ~ eco_value))$coefficients[2, 4],
      rho = suppressWarnings(cor(eco_value, yval, method = "spearman")),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(label = sprintf("R\u00B2 = %.3f, p = %.3f\n\u03C1 = %.2f", r2, p, rho))

  ggplot(long, aes(eco_value, yval)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "black", fill = "grey85") +
    geom_point(aes(colour = true_type), size = 3) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = site, colour = true_type), size = 3,
                    show.legend = FALSE, seed = 1, max.overlaps = Inf,
                    box.padding = 0.5) +
    geom_text(data = stats, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
              hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.2, size = 3.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Barren = "firebrick3", Macro_Forest = "steelblue3"),
                        name = "Habitat") +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = "n = 6 sites", x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

```{r}

run_stepwise_condensed <- function(response, data = site_data_condensed) {
  null_model <- lm(as.formula(paste(response, "~ 1")), data = data)
  full_model <- lm(as.formula(paste(response, "~ red_urchin_density +",
                                    "red_urchin_biomass + green_urchin_density +",
                                    "stipe_density")), data = data)
  step_model <- step(null_model,
                     scope     = list(lower = null_model, upper = full_model),
                     direction = "forward",
                     k         = log(nrow(data)),
                     trace     = 0)
  print(summary(step_model))
  cat("Adjusted R2:", round(summary(step_model)$adj.r.squared, 4), "\n")
  cat("Terms retained:",
      paste(attr(terms(step_model), "term.labels"), collapse = " + "), "\n")
  invisible(step_model)
}

step_prob_condensed <- run_stepwise_condensed("mean_prob")
step_pc1_condensed  <- run_stepwise_condensed("mean_pc1")
```

# New modeling for PC1

```{r}
library(lmerTest)   
library(pbkrtest)    

FULL_DATES <- as.character(c("2025-07-24", "2025-07-25", "2025-07-26", "2025-07-27"))

md_hourly <- habitat_model_data %>%
  filter(as.character(DATE) %in% FULL_DATES) %>%      # the 4 full days
  group_by(SITE, TYPE, DATE, HOUR) %>%
  summarise(pc1 = mean(urchin_pc1, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_seg = n(),                               # segments per hour 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(TYPE  = factor(TYPE),
         LDATE = factor(DATE),
         Hour  = factor(HOUR),
         SITE  = factor(SITE))

# should be ~ 6 sites x 4 dates x 24 hours = 576 rows
nrow(md_hourly)
table(md_hourly$LDATE)          # 4 dates
range(md_hourly$n_seg)          # how many segments went into each hourly mean
```

```{r}
m_pc1_hourly <- lmerTest::lmer(
  pc1 ~ TYPE * LDATE * Hour + (1 | TYPE:SITE),
  data = md_hourly, REML = TRUE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

anova(m_pc1_hourly, type = 3, ddf = "Kenward-Roger")             
print(VarCorr(m_pc1_hourly), comp = "Variance")
```

```{r}
# residual diagnostics for m_pc1_hourly
plot(m_pc1_hourly)                              # residuals vs fitted — look for funnel/curve
qqnorm(resid(m_pc1_hourly)); qqline(resid(m_pc1_hourly))   # normality of residuals
hist(resid(m_pc1_hourly), breaks = 30)
```

```{r}
#fit
cca_svm_v2 <- fit_urchin_svm_condensed(
  raw          = cca_v2_raw,
  urchin_label = "cca_urchin",
  absent_label = "cca_no_urchin",
  present_out  = "URCHIN_CCA",
  absent_out   = "NO_URCHIN_CCA"
)
```

```{r}

ok <- complete.cases(habitat_model_data[, c("ACI", "NDSI")])

# decision value (continuous signed score, like PC1)
habitat_model_data$cca_v2_decision <- NA_real_
habitat_model_data$cca_v2_decision[ok] <- predict(
  cca_svm_v2$model,
  newdata = habitat_model_data[ok, c("ACI", "NDSI")],
  type    = "decision"
)[, 1]

# probability (0-1, for the bar plots and stepwise)
habitat_model_data$cca_v2_prob <- NA_real_
habitat_model_data$cca_v2_prob[ok] <- predict(
  cca_svm_v2$model,
  newdata = habitat_model_data[ok, c("ACI", "NDSI")],
  type    = "probabilities"
)[, levels(cca_svm_v2$data$TYPE)[1]]

cat("Decision value range:", paste(round(range(habitat_model_data$cca_v2_decision,
    na.rm = TRUE), 3), collapse = " to "), "\n")
cat("Probability range:   ", paste(round(range(habitat_model_data$cca_v2_prob,
    na.rm = TRUE), 3), collapse = " to "), "\n")

# sign check: higher decision value should = more urchin-like
if (cor(habitat_model_data$cca_v2_decision,
        habitat_model_data$cca_v2_prob, use = "complete.obs") < 0) {
  habitat_model_data$cca_v2_decision <- -habitat_model_data$cca_v2_decision
  cat("Sign flipped to align with probability\n")
}

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# ---- Build site-level summary for urchin_pc1_v3 ----
site_data_pc1_v3 <- habitat_model_data_1min %>%
  group_by(Site, TYPE) %>%
  summarise(mean_pc1_v3 = mean(urchin_pc1_v3, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_pc1_v3   = sd(urchin_pc1_v3, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")

# ---- by type ----
pc1_by_type_v3 <- site_data_pc1_v3 %>%
  mutate(type_label = factor(TYPE, levels = c("Macrocystis Forest", "Urchin Barren"))) %>%
  group_by(type_label) %>%
  summarise(pc1_mean = mean(mean_pc1_v3, na.rm = TRUE),
            pc1_se   = sd(mean_pc1_v3, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")

p_pc1_type_v3 <- ggplot(pc1_by_type_v3, aes(type_label, pc1_mean, fill = type_label)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pc1_mean - pc1_se, ymax = pc1_mean + pc1_se),
                width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_label(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", pc1_mean),
                 y = pc1_mean + sign(pc1_mean) * (pc1_se + 0.05)),
             size = 3.3, colour = "grey20", fill = "white",
             label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.1, "lines")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "Macrocystis Forest" = expression(italic("Macrocystis") ~ "Forest"),
    "Urchin Barren"      = "Urchin Barren")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.08))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean urchin PC1 v3 (balanced, 1-min)\n(higher = more urchin)") +
  hab_fill() + guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_urchin(base_size = 13)

# ---- by site ----
pc1_by_site_v3 <- site_data_pc1_v3 %>%
  mutate(site_label = factor(tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", Site)),
                             levels = SITE_ORDER),
         type_label = factor(TYPE, levels = c("Macrocystis Forest", "Urchin Barren")))
stopifnot(!anyNA(pc1_by_site_v3$site_label))

  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", mean_pc1_v3),
                vjust = ifelse(mean_pc1_v3 >= 0, -0.5, 1.3)),
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# ---- 1. Fit habitat SVM on a stratified subsample of the raw 1-sec data ----

train_1sec <- habitat_model_data_1sec %>%
  group_by(TYPE) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 10000) %>%
  ungroup()

habitat_svm_1sec <- ksvm(
  TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI + AEI + ADI,
  data       = train_1sec,
  kernel     = SVM_KERNEL,
  kpar       = list(sigma = SVM_SIGMA),
  C          = SVM_COST,
  prob.model = TRUE,
  scaled     = TRUE
)

habitat_model_data_1sec$prob_barren_1sec <- probs_1sec_full[, "Urchin Barren"]
```

```{r}
  slice_sample(n = 100000)   # plotting subsample only; lm() below still uses full data

lm_pc1_v3_1sec <- lm(prob_barren_1sec ~ urchin_pc1_v3_1sec, data = habitat_model_data_1sec)
r2_1sec   <- summary(lm_pc1_v3_1sec)$r.squared
pval_1sec <- summary(lm_pc1_v3_1sec)$coefficients[2, 4]
plab_1sec <- if (pval_1sec < 2e-16) "P < 2e-16" else paste0("P = ", format(pval_1sec, digits = 2))

ggplot(plot_sample_1sec, aes(urchin_pc1_v3_1sec, prob_barren_1sec)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.05, size = 0.3, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", colour = "steelblue", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("R\u00B2 = ", round(r2_1sec, 3), ", ", plab_1sec),
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 4.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Urchin PC1 v3 (balanced 3-SVM, raw 1-sec)",
       y = "Probability of assignment as urchin barrens (SVM, raw 1-sec)")
```

# 1 second - Habitat SVM

### Loading site indices

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

all_data_1sec <- rbind(
  transform(filtered_samsing_cove_1sec,  site = "Samsing Cove",  type = "Urchin Barren"),
  transform(filtered_sandy_cove_1sec,    site = "Sandy Cove",    type = "Urchin Barren"),
  transform(filtered_harris_island_1sec, site = "Harris Island",  type = "Urchin Barren"),
  transform(filtered_crow_island_1sec,   site = "Crow Island",   type = "Macrocystis Forest"),
  transform(filtered_middle_island_1sec, site = "Middle Island", type = "Macrocystis Forest"),
  transform(filtered_battery_island_1sec,site = "Battery Island",type = "Macrocystis Forest")
)


all_data_1sec$type <- factor(all_data_1sec$type, levels = c("Macrocystis Forest", "Urchin Barren"))
all_data_1sec$site <- factor(all_data_1sec$site, levels = SITE_ORDER)

#timezone conversion
stopifnot(inherits(all_data_1sec$full_datetime, "POSIXct"))

# force UTC attribute if it is missing
if (is.null(attr(all_data_1sec$full_datetime, "tzone")) || attr(all_data_1sec$full_datetime, "tzone") == "") {
  attr(all_data_1sec$full_datetime, "tzone") <- SOURCE_TZ
}

# Convert timezone and create local tracking columns
all_data_1sec <- all_data_1sec %>%
  mutate(
    dt_local = with_tz(full_datetime, SITE_TZ),
    DATE     = as.Date(dt_local, tz = SITE_TZ),
    HOUR     = hour(dt_local)
  ) 

# check
cat("UTC vs Sitka offset check:\n")

print(head(data.frame(
  utc   = format(all_data_1sec$full_datetime[1:3], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"),
  local = format(all_data_1sec$dt_local[1:3], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"),
  DATE  = all_data_1sec$DATE[1:3],
  HOUR  = all_data_1sec$HOUR[1:3]
)))

# Double check that the data successfully sorted into your factor structures
table(all_data_1sec$site)
table(all_data_1sec$type)

```

```{r}
names(all_data_1sec)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(kernlab)

# Prepare 1-second SVM dataset
habitat_model_data_1sec <- all_data_1sec %>%
  dplyr::select(
    TYPE = type,
    ACI,
    NDSI,
    AEI,
    ADI
  ) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.))

# Make sure habitat type is a factor
habitat_model_data_1sec$TYPE <- factor(
  habitat_model_data_1sec$TYPE,
  levels = c("Macrocystis Forest", "Urchin Barren")
)
```

### Fitting svm

```{r}
# fit svm

habitat_svm_model_1sec <- ksvm(
  TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI + AEI + ADI,
  data       = habitat_model_data_1sec,
  kernel     = SVM_KERNEL,
  kpar       = list(sigma = SVM_SIGMA),
  C          = SVM_COST,
  prob.model = TRUE,
  scaled     = TRUE
)

cat("1-second SVM support vectors:",
    habitat_svm_model_1sec@nSV, "\n")
```

```{r}
nrow(all_data_1sec)
```

### Subsampled SVM

```{r}
set.seed(123)
habitat_model_data_1sec_sub <- habitat_model_data_1sec %>%
  group_by(TYPE) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 5000) %>%   
  ungroup()

habitat_svm_model_1sec <- ksvm(
  TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI + AEI + ADI,
  data       = habitat_model_data_1sec_sub,
  kernel     = SVM_KERNEL,
  kpar       = list(sigma = SVM_SIGMA),
  C          = SVM_COST,
  prob.model = TRUE,
  scaled     = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
library(caret)  # for confusionMatrix

# ---- Option A: Test on all rows NOT used in training ----
# (recommended - avoids testing on data the model already saw)

test_data <- habitat_model_data_1sec %>%
  anti_join(habitat_model_data_1sec_sub, by = c("TYPE", "ACI", "NDSI", "AEI", "ADI"))

# Predict class labels
pred_class <- predict(habitat_svm_model_1sec, newdata = test_data, type = "response")

# Predict probabilities (since prob.model = TRUE)
pred_prob <- predict(habitat_svm_model_1sec, newdata = test_data, type = "probabilities")

# Confusion matrix + accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, kappa, etc.
conf_mat <- confusionMatrix(pred_class, test_data$TYPE)
print(conf_mat)

# ---- Option B: Quick manual accuracy check ----
accuracy <- mean(pred_class == test_data$TYPE)
cat("Accuracy on held-out data:", round(accuracy, 4), "\n")

# ---- Option C: Add predictions back for inspection/plotting ----
test_data$pred_class <- pred_class
test_data$pred_prob_MacrocystisForest <- pred_prob[, "Macrocystis Forest"]
test_data$pred_prob_UrchinBarren      <- pred_prob[, "Urchin Barren"]

head(test_data)
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
sizes <- c(500, 1000, 2500, 5000, 10000, 20000)
results <- data.frame()

# hold out a fixed test set once, outside the loop
test_idx <- sample(nrow(habitat_model_data_1sec), 50000)
test_data <- habitat_model_data_1sec[test_idx, ]
train_pool <- habitat_model_data_1sec[-test_idx, ]

for (n in sizes) {
  train_sub <- train_pool %>%
    group_by(TYPE) %>%
    slice_sample(n = n) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  m <- ksvm(TYPE ~ ACI + NDSI + AEI + ADI, data = train_sub,
            kernel = SVM_KERNEL, kpar = list(sigma = SVM_SIGMA),
            C = SVM_COST, prob.model = FALSE, scaled = TRUE)
  
  pred <- predict(m, newdata = test_data)
  acc <- mean(pred == test_data$TYPE)
  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(n = n, accuracy = acc))
  cat("n =", n, "accuracy =", round(acc, 4), "\n")
}

print(results)
```

```{r}
# ---- Aggregate to 1-minute windows (per site, to avoid mixing recordings across sites) ----
habitat_model_data_1min <- all_data_1sec %>%
  mutate(time_bin = floor_date(full_datetime, "1 minute")) %>%
  group_by(Site, type, time_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    across(c(ACI, NDSI, AEI, ADI), mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_seconds = n(),   # how many 1-sec obs went into this window
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_seconds >= 30) %>%   # drop windows with too few seconds (sparse/edge windows)
  rename(TYPE = type) %>%
  mutate(TYPE = factor(TYPE, levels = c("Macrocystis Forest", "Urchin Barren"))) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.))
```
