```{r}
            cca_se   = sd(mean_cca_v2_prob_1min, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")

cca_by_site_1min <- site_data_cca_1min %>%
  mutate(site_label = factor(tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", Site)),
                             levels = SITE_ORDER),
         type_label = factor(TYPE, levels = c("Macrocystis Forest", "Urchin Barren")))
stopifnot(!anyNA(cca_by_site_1min$site_label))

# by type
p_cca_type_1min <- ggplot(cca_by_type_1min, aes(type_label, cca_mean, fill = type_label)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = cca_mean - cca_se, ymax = cca_mean + cca_se),
                width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_label(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", cca_mean),
                 y = cca_mean + cca_se + 0.05),
             size = 3.3, colour = "grey20", fill = "white",
             label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.1, "lines")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "Macrocystis Forest" = expression(italic("Macrocystis") ~ "Forest"),
    "Urchin Barren"      = "Urchin Barren")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.08))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean CCA v2 urchin probability (1-min)\n(higher = more urchin)") +
  hab_fill() + guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_urchin(base_size = 13)

# by site
p_cca_site_1min <- ggplot(cca_by_site_1min, aes(site_label, mean_cca_v2_prob_1min, fill = type_label)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", mean_cca_v2_prob_1min)),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3, colour = "grey40") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.08))) +
  labs(x = "Site", y = "Mean CCA v2 urchin probability, 1-min (higher = more urchin)") +
  hab_fill("Site type") +
  theme_urchin(base_size = 13, angle_x = 30)

p_cca_type_1min; p_cca_site_1min
```

```{r}
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +   # a probability cannot leave [0,1]
  theme_classic() +

       y = "Probability of assignment as urchin barrens (SVM, 1-min)")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# ---- Build a SEPARATE 1-min site_data, never overwriting the original site_data ----
site_scores_1min <- habitat_model_data_1min %>%
  mutate(site_key = tolower(gsub(" ", "_", Site))) %>%
  group_by(site_key) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_prob_1min        = mean(prob_barren_1min, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_cca_v2_prob_1min = mean(cca_v2_prob_1min,  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Join onto a fresh copy of the core survey columns (never mutates the original site_data object)
site_data_1min <- site_data %>%
  select(-matches("^mean_prob|^mean_cca|^mean_pc1")) %>%   # in case this is re-run, strip any stale copies first
  mutate(site_key = tolower(gsub(" ", "_", site))) %>%
  left_join(site_scores_1min, by = "site_key") %>%
  select(-site_key)

stopifnot(!anyNA(site_data_1min$mean_prob_1min), !anyNA(site_data_1min$mean_cca_v2_prob_1min))
names(site_data_1min)   # sanity check - mean_prob_1min / mean_cca_v2_prob_1min, no .x/.y

# Stepwise selection function (unchanged, generic on response name + data)
run_stepwise <- function(response, data = site_data_1min) {
  null_model <- lm(as.formula(paste(response, "~ 1")), data = data)
  full_model <- lm(as.formula(paste(response, "~ red_urchin_density +",
                                    "red_urchin_biomass + green_urchin_density +",
                                    "stipe_density")), data = data)
  step_model <- step(null_model,
                     scope     = list(lower = null_model, upper = full_model),
                     direction = "forward",
                     k         = log(nrow(data)),
                     trace     = 0)
  print(summary(step_model))
  cat("Adjusted R2:", round(summary(step_model)$adj.r.squared, 4), "\n")
  cat("Terms retained:",
      paste(attr(terms(step_model), "term.labels"), collapse = " + "), "\n")
  invisible(step_model)
}

step_habitat_1min <- run_stepwise("mean_prob_1min")
step_cca_1min      <- run_stepwise("mean_cca_v2_prob_1min")
```

### Ecological Relationships

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# New helper for the 1-min habitat SVM and CCA v2 SVM, kept separate from make_eco_panel
make_eco_panel_1min <- function(site_df, yvar, ylab, title) {
  long <- site_df %>%
    select(site, true_type, all_of(yvar), all_of(names(ECO_VARS))) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(names(ECO_VARS)),
                 names_to = "variable", values_to = "eco_value") %>%
    rename(yval = all_of(yvar)) %>%
    mutate(variable = factor(ECO_VARS[variable], levels = ECO_VARS)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(eco_value), !is.na(yval))

  stats <- long %>%
    group_by(variable) %>%
    summarise(
      r2  = summary(lm(yval ~ eco_value))$r.squared,
      p   = summary(lm(yval ~ eco_value))$coefficients[2, 4],
      rho = suppressWarnings(cor(eco_value, yval, method = "spearman")),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(label = sprintf("R\u00B2 = %.3f, p = %.3f\n\u03C1 = %.2f", r2, p, rho))

  ggplot(long, aes(eco_value, yval)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "black", fill = "grey85") +
    geom_point(aes(colour = true_type), size = 3) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = site, colour = true_type), size = 3,
                    show.legend = FALSE, seed = 1, max.overlaps = Inf,
                    box.padding = 0.5) +
    geom_text(data = stats, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
              hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.2, size = 3.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Barren = "red", Macro_Forest = "blue"),
                        name = "Habitat") +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = "n = 6 sites",
         x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

# Run for the 1-min habitat SVM
p_eco_habitat_1min <- make_eco_panel_1min(
  site_df = site_data_1min,
  yvar    = "mean_prob_1min",
  ylab    = "Mean probability of assignment as urchin barren (SVM, 1-min)",
  title   = "Habitat SVM (1-min aggregated) vs. ecological variables"
)

# Run for the CCA v2 SVM 
p_eco_cca_1min <- make_eco_panel_1min(
  site_df = site_data_1min,
  yvar    = "mean_cca_v2_prob_1min",
  ylab    = "Mean CCA v2 urchin probability (1-min)",
  title   = "CCA v2 urchin SVM (1-min aggregated) vs. ecological variables"
)

p_eco_habitat_1min
p_eco_cca_1min
```
